page.overview:
Who is Emmett Tucker?

Emmett Tucker is a major character who debuts in Fazbear Frights 11: Prankster's third story, Find Player Two!.

Emmett is a tall and skinny guy in his early forties with long, greasy hair. He has dark, almost-black eyes. Emmett has yellowed and crooked teeth, and his face heavily wrinkled, getting compared to a wrinkled Halloween mask by Aimee. He wears stained, baggy clothes.

After being released from prison ten years later, Emmett has replaced his long hair with a buzz-cut, a scar bisects his left cheek, and he’s lost a few teeth. His skin is so thin that his veins are visible.

Emmett originally appears to be a creepy man stalking children at Freddy Fazbear's Pizza. However, this is not the case. It is revealed that he was looking for his daughter and was in the middle of a custody dispute with his ex-wife.
